instructions.purpose: Search through stored conversation memories to recall past messages, preferences, or information shared by the user. Use this tool when the user asks about something they previously mentioned, or when recalling past context would improve your response.

tool.name: search-memory
tool.description: Queries the memory database for the current conversation. The chat context is handled automatically - you only need to provide optional filters. Results are sorted by importance (high first), then by last read date, then by creation date. Returns the matching memories or an empty list if nothing is found.

instructions.response_handling: Skip the tool when memory recall is not needed. Treat an empty result as no matching context. Do not fabricate memories.
instructions.filter_priority: Prefer the following order of filters, but you do not need to use a previous filter to use the next one: 1. searchString - partial text match on message content 2. timeRange - filter by creation date range (start and end in ISO 8601 format with explicit Z or numeric timezone offsets) 3. limit - cap the number of results 4. importance - filter by one or more importance levels (low, medium, high)

usage_rules.rule: Call this tool when the task concerns past information or recalling context is essential
Use searchString to narrow results when the user references a specific topic
Use timeRange when the user mentions a specific time period
Always include an explicit Z or numeric timezone offset in timeRange start and end values
Use limit to avoid overwhelming context with too many results (prefer 5-10)
Use importance to filter by memory importance when relevant
Use an empty argument object for a broad memory search with no filters

example.context: User says: "Przypomnij mi co mówiłem o moim ulubionym jedzeniu"
example.reasoning: Search for memories mentioning favorite food, limited to 5 results.

example.context: Current date is 2099-01-27. User says: "What did I tell you about my job in the last seven days?"
example.reasoning: User is asking about work-related information from the last seven days. Search with text and time filters computed from the supplied current date in the {{config.ai.instructions.timezone}} timezone.
Casual greeting with no need to search past memories.
